domains.name: Personal Context, Learning, and Transfer
domains.purpose: Understand the person over time and use learned patterns, preferences, skills, constraints, and outcomes to improve future support.
owns: local learning from behavior and outcomes
cross-domain transfer of learned strategies or skills
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the durable promise is that Ambitions learns from or transfers what is known about the person; route the resulting plan, simulation, search, or execution behavior to its own primary domain.

domains.name: Goals, Paths, and Progression
domains.purpose: Help a person form meaningful pursuits, understand the path toward them, and preserve coherent progression across changing circumstances.
owns: cross-surface projection of canonical goal paths
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the durable promise concerns the pursuit and its path; use execution, time, simulation, or knowledge domains when the promise remains meaningful without a goal path.

domains.name: Present Execution and Adaptation
domains.purpose: Help a person understand what is executable now, act with appropriate context, and adapt present work without collapsing into a task list.
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the promise is about acting now; route durable path structure, chronology, or recovery guarantees to their owning domains.

domains.name: Time, Capacity, and Reflow
domains.purpose: Help a person place, understand, and revise commitments against real chronology, capacity, dependencies, and disruption.
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the promise changes or explains temporal placement, capacity, sequence, or reflow; a goal path may depend on it without transferring path ownership.

domains.name: Simulation and Decision Support
domains.purpose: Let a person explore plausible alternatives, trade-offs, consequences, and uncertainty before committing their real life graph.
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when alternatives remain hypothetical and reversible; once a path is accepted, ownership transfers to the applicable goal, time, or execution domain.

domains.name: Search, Command, and Inspection
domains.purpose: Let a person privately find, understand, inspect, ask about, and act on Ambitions objects and relationships from a global native command surface.
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Search owns discovery and invocation, never the canonical object or mutation semantics it exposes.

domains.name: Knowledge, Files, and Attachments
domains.purpose: Keep supporting information, files, references, notes, and provenance durably attached to the life objects they inform.
owns: searchable local knowledge associated with life objects
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the promise is durable knowledge custody and relationship; use sharing when the primary promise is external presentation or transfer.

domains.name: Sharing and External Expression
domains.purpose: Help a person deliberately transform and share selected Ambitions content while preserving meaning, privacy, provenance, and audience control.
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when content leaves or is prepared to leave the private Ambitions context; the source object remains owned by its original domain.

domains.name: Identity, Privacy, and Trust
domains.purpose: Give the person legible control over who Ambitions understands them to be, what data exists, how it is used, and why the system acted.
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the durable promise is control, legibility, consent, or trust; other domains may depend on it but cannot absorb privacy ownership.

domains.name: Appearance and Personal Expression
domains.purpose: Let a person meaningfully shape Ambitions' visual expression within native, accessible, coherent product boundaries.
owns: preview and safe application of appearance choices
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the person is deliberately authoring the private product's expression; visual-system implementation remains design authority, not a capability domain.

domains.name: Resilience, Recovery, and Continuity
domains.purpose: Keep Ambitions understandable and useful through offline operation, stale or partial information, interruption, conflict, failure, and restoration.
does_not_own: cloud synchronization as a product promise by itself
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the promise is that another capability remains trustworthy under degraded conditions; retain the affected capability as a secondary domain.

domains.name: Capture and Interpretation
domains.purpose: Let a person express something quickly, preserve it provisionally, inspect interpretation, and place it without premature commitment.
does_not_own: voice technology as an end in itself
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Capture owns intake and provisional interpretation; ownership transfers when the person accepts placement into a canonical object or domain.

domains.name: Reflection, Proof, and Closure
domains.purpose: Help a person understand what changed, preserve meaningful evidence, reflect on outcomes, and close work without losing history.
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain when the person-facing promise concerns completed consequence, evidence, reflection, or durable closure rather than ongoing execution.

domains.name: Apple Ecosystem and Automation
domains.purpose: Extend Ambitions coherently through native Apple platforms, system surfaces, and user-authorized automation without weakening local-first control.
owns: cross-device continuity as experienced by the person
does_not_own: capabilities merely because they use an Apple API
domains.anti_overlap_rule: Use this domain only when native ecosystem reach is itself part of the durable user promise; otherwise treat Apple technology as implementation support.

assignments.assignment_rationale: The defining promise is reuse of learned personal capability across domains; pathing and simulation are downstream applications.
The outcome is a coherent goal path, while personal learning, temporal feasibility, and scenario exploration inform its generation.
The alternatives remain hypothetical until chosen; personal context, path structure, and temporal consequences support the simulation.
The durable promise is dependency- and capacity-aware temporal repair after placement; the affected path and present work remain secondary.
Global private retrieval, inspection, and command are primary; trust boundaries and native Apple reach constrain the experience.
The person is authoring Ambitions' visual expression; identity and accessibility boundaries support but do not own it.
The defining outcome is deliberate external expression, supported by privacy control and source-content relationships.
Durable custody and relationship of files is primary; goals provide attachment context and Search provides retrieval.
The journey is a global retrieval-to-action-to-inspection promise, with trust inspection as a required boundary.
Search-grounded asking extends retrieval and command while depending on personal context and explicit trust inspection.

assignments.candidate_name: Canonical Goal Path Projection Across Surfaces
assignments.assignment_rationale: The canonical path remains the durable identity while Today, Time, Motion, Search, and Trust expose projections without taking ownership.
The promise is continued trustworthy use of Today under degraded conditions, with present execution and disclosure boundaries retained.
The defining promise is deterministic local Search continuity and recovery when external connectivity is unavailable.
